articles.title: Cyprus’s desire to buy BrahMos, Kamikaze drones from India alarms Turkey

articles.title: Steven Spielberg slams AI replacing writers and creativity in filmmaking; says, 'I don't believe there is any substitute for the soul'
articles.summary: Renowned filmmaker Steven Spielberg has voiced strong opposition to Artificial intelligence (AI) replacing human writers and creativity in the film industry. Spielberg emphasized that AI cannot substitute the 'soul' inherent in human artistic expression. His comments highlight a growing debate within creative fields regarding the ethical and artistic implications of advanced AI technologies, stressing the irreplaceable value of human originality in storytelling.
